=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1792-1836 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_mt_merge_lease_tick`, when the skip-filtered queue is empty the fallback clears `tick_queue_skips` and retries, so a skip-held waiter can be re-granted the lease on its unchanged head; the held write in `_merge_lease_write` (pr_checks_lib.sh:2224-2227) then drops that PR's own skip entry.
  WHY: This breaks the binding D4 contract and the Phase 2 test criterion (docs/plans/merge-lease-parallel-merges-plan.md:60-61, line 335) that a skip entry blocks re-grant until the head changes. It allows repeated re-grants that block later waiters for 60 or 240 minutes, and the tick logs both `outcome=skipped reason=skip_head_unchanged` and `outcome=granted` for the same PR. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and openai_gpt-6-luna rate it MAJOR; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rates it NIT because eligibility is re-checked, the fallback mirrors the plan-sanctioned lone-caller gate rule (pr_checks_lib.sh:2590-2610), and it prevents a lone labelled waiter from being stranded. The highest (MAJOR→high) is used.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2424-2427 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The cancelled-CI early `return 0` in `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` exits before the `case` block that sets `MERGE_LEASE_CI_ACTIVE`, so the value stays `unknown` even though `PR_CHECKS_RUNS_READ=true` and `PR_CHECKS_RUNS_PENDING=0`. The idle-holder path in `_mt_merge_lease_tick` (scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1729-1736) then calls `_pr_head_ci_runs_pending` a second time.
  WHY: Each tick with an idle holder whose CI runs were all cancelled (or hit startup_failure) makes one redundant `actions/runs?head_sha=` REST call. This violates the tick header's §14 budget of "at most one `actions/runs` read" (review_merge_train.sh:1602-1627). The decision is still correct. All reviewers rated it NIT. Suggested fix: `[ "${PR_CHECKS_RUNS_READ:-}" = "true" ] && MERGE_LEASE_CI_ACTIVE="false"` before `return 0`.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1782-1833 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: If the grant loop in `_mt_merge_lease_tick` exhausts all candidates with `tick_first` empty, execution continues to `tick_first_head="$(jq -r --argjson n "${tick_first}" ...)"`, which assumes `tick_first` holds a valid PR number.
  WHY: Running `jq --argjson` with an empty `tick_first` can fail or leave the rest of the tick in an unexpected state. The source stated no severity.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:`_mt_merge_lease_tick`, lines 1792-1799; grant write at line 1836 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the skip-filtered queue is empty, the fallback clears the skip list and retries, so a labelled waiter whose `skip=<pr>:<head>` entry still matches its head is re-granted on that same head. The held write drops the grantee's entry. `tests/test_merge_lease.py::test_lone_skip_held_waiter_is_granted_when_nobody_else_is_eligible` locks this behaviour in.
  WHY: This contradicts D4 and plan line 335 ("A skip entry blocks a re-grant until the head changes, in both the tick and the update-mode gate") and plan line 248. A lone expired or revoked PR is re-granted, `_mt_dispatch_review` runs again, and later waiters are blocked for 60 or 240 minutes. The cycle can repeat indefinitely, and the log contradicts itself (line 1782 `skipped` and then `granted`). Suggested alternative: unlabel the skip-held waiters when nothing else is eligible.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:`_merge_lease_pr_eligible`, lines 2424-2427 (caller scripts/review_merge_train.sh lines 1729-1735) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The early return exits before the `case` block, so `MERGE_LEASE_CI_ACTIVE` stays `unknown` even though the runs were already read (pr_checks_lib.sh lines 1182, 1196-1199). The tick then calls `_pr_head_ci_runs_pending` again (line 1731).
  WHY: One redundant `actions/runs?head_sha=` call per tick breaks the §14 budget. Fix: `[ "${PR_CHECKS_RUNS_READ:-}" = "true" ] && MERGE_LEASE_CI_ACTIVE="false"` before `return 0`.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: Plan 2.6: "Env (defaults in `pr_checks_lib.sh`, wired as `${{ vars.X || 'default' }}` in the four workflows)"; the rollback is "set the variable to `false`".
  Expected change site: the merge-lease `env:` lines in `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`, `.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml`, `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`, `.github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml`.
  Evidence of absence: No workflow file changed. The agents.d and changelog.d fragments say the variables are "not yet wired" (the deferral comes from the PR itself). The rollback cannot reach the helpers, and the files_touched grant omits these workflows.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: "`README.md`: rows next to the `MERGE_LEASE_*` rows at 151-155 (Phases 2-5)".
  Expected change site: the `MERGE_LEASE_*` variable table in `README.md`.
  Evidence of absence: README.md is unchanged, with no rows for `MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED` or `MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES`. The editor deferred this.
- HARDENING (2 related items; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1): (1) scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` lines 2424-2427: set `MERGE_LEASE_CI_ACTIVE="false"` when `PR_CHECKS_RUNS_READ` is true (1 line). (2) scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` head-gate grace branch after `[ "${elig_idle}" -gt 0 ] || elig_idle=3600`: the following `[ "${elig_idle}" -gt 0 ]` term is always true (dead condition); drop it (1 line).
